title: The Unfinished Manuscript
text:
Elena found the old notebook tucked inside a bookshelf in her grandmother's house. Its pages were yellowed, and the handwriting was small and careful. Each entry described a town she had never heard of, along with characters who seemed to be waiting for their stories to be completed.

She spent the whole evening reading in silence. Near the end, the writer apologized for leaving the final chapter unwritten, explaining that a sudden illness had interrupted the work. Elena decided that she would complete the story herself, although she knew her version would never match the original voice.

questions.text: Where did Elena find the notebook?
options: In a library in the town centre
Inside a bookshelf in her grandmother's house
Under her bed at her own flat
In a box at the local post office

questions.text: What did the writer apologize for?
options: For leaving the final chapter unwritten

questions.text: Why did Elena decide to finish the story herself?
options: She wanted to sell the notebook for money
She felt a personal connection to the unfinished story
She wanted to correct the spelling in the notebook
She had been asked to do so by a publisher

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the writer of the notebook?
options: They were ill and could not finish their work
They had written the story in another language
They lived in the same town as Elena

stopped something from continuing for a time
not yet written down or completed
a condition in which a person is not healthy

paragraph_translations: Elena znalazła stary notatnik schowany na półce z książkami w domu swojej babci. Jego strony były pożółkłe, a pismo małe i staranne. Każdy wpis opisywał miasteczko, o którym nigdy nie słyszała, oraz postaci, które zdawały się czekać na dokończenie swoich historii.

Spędziła cały wieczór, czytając w ciszy. Pod koniec autor przeprosił za to, że zostawił ostatni rozdział niedokończony, i wyjaśnił, że nagła choroba przerwała jego pracę. Elena postanowiła sama dokończyć historię, choć wiedziała, że jej wersja nigdy nie dorówna oryginalnemu stylowi.
